title: Workflow rules run after some blueprint transitions but not others
date: 22 Oct 2026 (times on screen are local, UTC+3)
sub: TAVI CRM crm.taviportal.com, Education First tenant (Ebhar Misr), record EM-00094 · Zoho side = Zoho help docs only, not checked on a live Zoho org

panels.caption: pool-science presses «اعتماد الفيديو — العلوم» (score + comments are required during-fields) → Execute at 10:59
1 min later: status Assessment Complete, owner still Pool — العلوم (hand-over rule did not run)
Settings → Execution History, filtered by this record: N02 ran after «قبول التسجيل»; nothing after the 10:59 transition
The rule that should have run: On edit · Application Status = Assessment Complete AND Application Status changed · owner round robin to Committee profile
Zoho CRM help: Troubleshooting Workflows
panels.flag: DOCS ONLY — not checked on a live Zoho org
text: “Workflow rules do not trigger when the fields are transitioned from a blueprint.”
“Workflows are not triggered when a record moves from one transition to another. This is because the record is already being processed in one automation (the blueprint)…”

“Solution: The actions that were configured in the blueprint can be scheduled in the After part of the blueprint … Then the workflow will be triggered when the record moves through the last transition.”

rows.b: On-edit workflow rule after a transition WITHOUT during-fields («قبول التسجيل» → N02, status = Registration Approved AND changed)
rows.tavi: Triggered — N02 Fired 10:58, portal access sent

rows.b: On-edit workflow rule after a transition WITH required during-fields («اعتماد الفيديو», score + comments)
Same rule shape (status = X AND status changed) gives a different result depending on the button
rows.tavi: Inconsistent: runs for buttons without fields, not for buttons with fields

rows.b: Zoho's way to act after a transition: actions in the blueprint After section
rows.tavi: After offers field update, email, webhook, notify owner — no owner assignment / round robin

notes: Request to the developers: pick ONE rule for whether workflow rules run after blueprint transitions, apply it to every transition, and document it.

Warning: the Ebhar flow depends on the current behaviour — N02 (portal access) runs only because rules fire after «قبول التسجيل». If transitions stop triggering rules, portal access must move into the blueprint (After) first.
Reproduced 3 times on 21 Oct (EM-00065, EM-00066, probe) and again on 22 Oct in the UI (EM-00094, kept for the developers).
